title: 3D quantitative phase imaging via the transport of intensity equation: applications for studying red blood cells
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,11655-11661
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01071C, Paper

Anusha Pillai, Saritha Kamath U., Sushma Belurkar, Anand K. Asundi, Ajeetkumar Patil
We present 3D quantitative phase microscopy using transport of intensity equation for investigating morphology of erythrocytes under different osmotic stress conditions. It is a label-free method can be used to study biophysical propertied of cells.
